Source contracts: scripts/installer_legal.sh

scripts/installer_legal.sh

Shell · Tier B

Verify source-installer terms and record acceptance for one invocation.

Usage

Source through installer_support.sh; compatible with Bash 3.2 before Python setup.

Inputs

Installer component/root, review and versioned acceptance flags; terminal answers are required unless both explicit document versions match the verified bundled terms.

Side effects

Displays terms and writes a private acceptance receipt under the selected SMTO data root. This helper does not provision packages or change product EULA consent.

Cleanup

Acceptance identity stays process-local; nested steps reverify document hashes. A later install, upgrade or repair must obtain acceptance again.

@see scripts/installer_support.sh
